title: improv·artist · industrial (Donald Judd)
mutation_directive: improv artist: industrial via Donald Judd

improv_extras.practice: stacked metal boxes; precise repetition; specificity of object

v1.feedback: Strong execution of Judd's specificity — 12 identical boxes at precise intervals with restrained aluminum palette and slow vertical camera pan that earns the motion. The particle-surface representation reads immediately as stacked volumes occupying proper frame space. Minor refinement: edge lines at 0.22 opacity fight the particle definition slightly; consider removing them entirely or pushing to 0.08-0.12 to let the particle density alone define the crisp rectangular forms. The subtle hue shift per box (baseHue + stackIdx gradient) is appropriate restraint for industrial seriality.

v2.feedback: Strong Judd execution: 12 identical boxes with precise interval spacing, restrained aluminum palette with subtle progression, and characteristically slow vertical pan that mimics gallery contemplation. The edge-biased particle distribution successfully creates crisp box definition. Minor refinement: the point size could be slightly smaller (1.8px) and the fog could be dialed back 30% — Judd's work has sharp presence even at distance, and the current fog softens the industrial specificity slightly too much.
